text:
mike: Quick heads-up: planning a tf apply for release v1.9 tonight. Changes: cross-account VPC peering, route53 TTL updates, small IAM role tweak. Quiet window 02:00-03:00 UTC. Need ops + network ack.
ryan: I can own oncall for the window. Suggest canary in us-east-1 (single AZ) first.
jen: I'll pin provider and module refs in tfvars (provider = 3.2.0) and include explicit module versions.
sara: Please add a deploybot override tag and freeze the merge queue 30m before window.
deploybot: deploybot: running preflight `terraform init && terraform plan` (workspace: release-v1.9)
deploybot: deploybot: plan: 1 iam change, 2 route53 updates, 1 vpc_peering to be created.
infra-bot: infra-bot: detected drift: route53 TTLs changed outside terraform (2024-01-10). Recommend reconcile in canary only.
sara: I'll open a ticket and reconcile the canary.
ryan: Canary steps:
1) `terraform apply -target=module.vpc_canary -var='region=us-east-1' -auto-approve`
2) wait 10m, run connectivity smoke tests
3) `terraform apply -target=module.dns_canary` if green.
jen: Rollback quick playbook:
- IAM failures: revoke policies via console, `git revert <sha>`, then `terraform apply -target=module.iam -auto-approve`
- DNS outage: revert record in console, then `terraform apply` to reconcile
- Escape hatch: cut traffic to backup region via LB health switch.
oncall-ops: I'll be live 01:50-03:30 UTC. Abort if deploybot shows >50% resource failures or prod error rate >5%.
mike: Locking merge queue at 01:30 UTC. Added infra change notes + contacts. Tagging @sre @security.
sara: Locked merges at 01:30; will unlock after 04:00 if all clear.
jen: Pushed provider pin + module refs. PR includes runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/infra-apply-evac
deploybot: deploybot: preflight complete 1: plan shows 1 IAM, 2 Route53, 1 VPC peering. Ready for canary.
mike: Canary scheduled for 02:10 UTC in us-east-1. If stable 10m, staged rollout (10m watch per region).
ryan: Canary apply started 02:10 UTC. Output: `Apply complete! Resources: 2 added, 0 changed, 0 destroyed. Outputs: canary_vpc_peering_id = "pcx-0a1b2c3d"`
sara: Noted DNS propagation lag in eu-west-1 for test record after TTL change to 60. Monitoring.
jen: Abort commands: `git revert <sha>`, `git push origin HEAD:release-v1.9`, `terraform apply -parallelism=1 -auto-approve`. Notify SRE to cut traffic if needed.
ryan: Canary stable at 12m, proceeding with next region at 02:25 UTC.
oncall-ops: If deploybot posts >3 failures in 5m we trigger rollback.
mike: Watching metrics: 5xx rate, route53 errors, cross-account VPC metrics. Will post final status when done. Thanks all :thumbsup:
